description: Get the full details for one outcome group by outcome_group_id within an account or course context, including its subgroups_url and outcomes_url. The ID comes from list_outcome_groups, list_outcome_group_subgroups, or get_root_outcome_group; use list_outcome_group_outcomes to list the outcomes linked under this group and list_outcome_group_subgroups to list this group's child groups.

context_id.description: The Canvas account ID or course ID for the context.

name: get_outcome_group
title: Get Outcome Group
